name: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
overview: Amazon EKS là managed Kubernetes service cung cấp Kubernetes control plane để chạy cluster workloads trên AWS.
examSignals: Kubernetes API/portable Kubernetes ecosystem required: EKS
AWS-native orchestration with less Kubernetes overhead: ECS
Containers without managing worker nodes: EKS Fargate or ECS Fargate when suitable

compareWith.diff: EKS vận hành Kubernetes-compatible clusters; ECS là AWS-native orchestrator không yêu cầu Kubernetes API.
